_: R40's promises, in one file, so changing one is a reviewable diff. Throughput is BYTES/sec, which is what Chrome's Network.emulateNetworkConditions takes.
_page_weight_note: R40's 60 KB. Counted as the document plus every stylesheet and script it blocks on. Measured: 13.9 KB heaviest.
_script_note: Tighter ceiling on the JavaScript a page blocks on; measured 6.7 KB. The map library is excluded deliberately and carries its own budget below. React + ReactDOM is ~45 KB gzipped and would hide inside the 60 KB page budget, so 'vanilla ES modules, no bundler' needs its own number.
_geometry_note: §6A.3's 300 KB, fetched after first paint. Both layers: 135 KB for the 51 council districts and 96 KB for the 59 community boards, at the pinned 2.2 m tolerance. The front-page map draws both, so unlike before this is no longer fetched only on the street-address path.
_map_library_note: The vendored MapLibre, on the front page only and imported after first paint, so it is not inside the 60 KB page budget and not inside the 12 KB script ceiling. It is gated here instead, because a dynamic import is invisible to a gate that reads the HTML. Measured 449 KB across maplibre-gl.mjs (292 KB), maplibre-gl-worker.mjs (147 KB) and maplibre-gl.css (10 KB).
_runs_note: §6A asks for p95 over at least 20 runs. At n=20 the p95 is the 19th ordered value, so one slow run cannot be averaged away.

3g-fast.label: 3G Fast, as WebPageTest defines it, plus a mid-tier Android CPU

3g-slow.label: Chrome DevTools' Slow 3G preset — reported, never gated

_profile_note: 3g-fast is the promise and the gate; measured 906/741/723 ms. 3g-slow measures 4.3-5.1 s and is printed but never gated: its 2000 ms round trip spends 6 s on three sequential trips before a byte of ours counts, so it measures the network, not our page. Both are CI measurements on a reference profile, never observed field percentiles — analytics are banned, so there is no field data.
